assessment: Specific guidance is restricted to the aggregate confirmation handler and exact own-data ROLLING_FUNDING_GAS_CHANGED code. Raw error messages and accessor values are not rendered. Other errors retain existing generic recovery guidance.

The existing confirmation handler clears the quote before attempting confirmation. Refusal leaves entered allocation and gas values intact; there is no automatic cap increase, quote, signature or payment. An edited amount requires Get fresh quote and another explicit confirmation.

The Ethereum journal maps errors after durable payment entry, including a late signer gas veto, to BB_ETH_SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN. Those uncertain errors do not match this new gas-specific handler; existing no-replay and reconciliation policy remain intact.
Claim scheduling, cryptographic and canonical checks, fees, custody, immutable signed records, network timeout and whole-cold bounds are unchanged.

No runtime/SDK loader or cold-recovery engine path is changed. The panel is served directly by the reader static handler, so no generated SDK/wallet input changes are required for this two-file change. Old-source cold observations do not establish current panel acceptance.
